senses.gloss:
√vañc (váñcati; vañcáyati; vañcitá).
totter; go crookedly; caus. (cause to go
astray, i. e.) mislead, deceive; cheat. [cf.
Lat. vacillare, ‘totter, be unsteady’; AS.
wōh, ‘crooked, wrong,’ whence Eng. woo,
‘incline to one's self, court.’]
+ upa, totter unto.

√vāñch (vā́ñchati; vāñchitá). wish. [for
*vānsk, orig. inchoative (cf. √1iṣ) to
√van, q. v.: cf. Ger. Wunsch, ‘a wish’;
AS. wūsc, ‘a wish,’ whence verb wȳscan,
‘wish,’ whence Eng. verb wish, whence
noun wish.]
